versions.name: Camp Alaflo (Heersink Scout Reservation)

features.note: Units line up in formation on the parade ground before each meal.
One ADA-compliant campsite with power, reserved for units with additional needs.
SCUBA BSA offered as an adventure program.
Off-camp high-adventure trips offered alongside the merit badge program.
Rawhide, the camp's first-year camper program.

versions.summary: A 520-acre summer camp near Enterprise, Alabama, serving Scouts BSA and Cub Scouts. Features an air-conditioned dining hall, Lake Essayon with a floating dock for canoeing, and archery, shotgun, and rifle ranges. Offers the Pathfinders first-year camper program, merit badges, and a high-adventure activity.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
